momentum_returns.mechanism: Price trends propagate through investor behavior over multiple sessions
momentum_returns.reason_effect_may_disappear: Short horizons dominated by noise; long horizons by regime shifts
momentum_returns.falsification: If IC does not vary systematically across horizons, horizon-mismatch explanation fails
momentum_returns.prior_evidence: Phases 9-13: IC ~0.02-0.04 at H-5; Phase 14.5: H-1 FRAGILE

volatility_dynamics.mechanism: Volatility regimes persist and mean-revert over multi-session periods
volatility_dynamics.reason_effect_may_disappear: Volatility is mean-reverting; signal may reverse at long horizons
volatility_dynamics.falsification: If volatility features show no horizon-dependent IC pattern, mechanism is not supported
volatility_dynamics.prior_evidence: Phase 14.5: H-4 FRAGILE, tested only at H-5 equivalent

macro_regime.mechanism: Macro conditions influence corporate earnings and discount rates over weeks to months
macro_regime.reason_effect_may_disappear: Macro data is revised (PIT limitation); effects are regime-dependent
macro_regime.falsification: If macro features show stronger IC at H-5 than H-20, mechanism is not supported
macro_regime.prior_evidence: Phase 15.2: H-3 IC ~0.13-0.15 but temporal instability; Phase 17A: regime-dependent

cross_sectional.mechanism: Relative strength/ranking captures mean-reversion and momentum across instruments
cross_sectional.reason_effect_may_disappear: Cross-sectional signals are sensitive to universe composition
cross_sectional.falsification: If cross-sectional features show no horizon variation, mechanism is not horizon-dependent
